statement:
let H := fun (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ℕ) (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) =>
  (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))) / (m.totient : ℂ)
∀ (m d : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero d] (N : ℕ), m.Coprime d →
  ∀ (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (ξ η : DirichletCharacter ℂ d),
    H (m*d) N
      (χ.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_right m d) * ξ.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_left d m))
      (ψ.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_right m d) * η.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_left d m)) =
      H m N χ ψ * H d N ξ η

plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0010 · Factor reflection cross terms across coprime moduli

brief.zh: 通过模环约化组合两侧特征。CRT 将单位与反射同时分解，欧拉函数相乘，故归一化系数也是两系数的乘积。
brief.en: Pull back the two characters by reduction. CRT splits both the units and the reflection and the totients multiply. The normalized entry is the product of the two entries.
